basics.name: Trishal Adabala
basics.label: Undergraduate Student Researcher
basics.summary: B.Tech student in Computer Science and Engineering with a specialization in AI/ML and a minor in Mathematics at Shiv Nadar University (GPA: 9.14/10). Undergraduate researcher working on continuous-latent language flows, high-dimensional vector quantization, and quantitative connectomics. Experienced in decentralized machine learning (HPE Swarm Learning) and systems engineering. Actively seeking PhD and Master's opportunities in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence.

education.area: Computer Science and Engineering (Specialization in AI/ML, Minor in Mathematics)

work.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE)
highlights: Scikit-Learn Integration: Extended HPE Swarm Learning to support Scikit-Learn models, enabling decentralized privacy-preserving training beyond the existing TensorFlow and PyTorch frameworks.

Testing & Validation: Validated and debugged the Scikit-Learn integration across multiple estimators to ensure compatibility with the existing Swarm Learning framework.

projects.name: Continuous Language Flows & Trajectory Retraction (ELF)
projects.description: Continuous-latent language flow matching, geometric manifold retraction, and causal local time clocks.
highlights: Discovered continuous flows outperform discrete masked diffusion (MDLM) by 13.5x in perplexity (13.49 vs 181.86 dedup-PPL) while running 3.2x faster at 4 steps.
Formulated Encoder-Cycle Projection (ECP), an idempotent manifold retraction operator (Pi = E o D) cutting 16-step ODE perplexity by 10.7% and boosting MAUVE coherence by +53.9%.
Mathematically proved the Wave-Step Resolution Theorem (N_eff = N/W) establishing the lower bound N >= 2W steps to avoid unigram entropy collapse.
Developed Clock-Modulated Encoder (CME) masking, reducing contextual noise leakage by >60% and enabling 100.0% hierarchical key-value copy accuracy.
Implemented Progressive Halving trajectory distillation, achieving 22.13 chrF translation in a single 2.2 ms step (5.1x over 1-step teacher).

projects.name: QuantPPI: Data-Oblivious Vector Quantization for Protein Embeddings
projects.description: High-dimensional geometry and signal processing framework for 1280-D protein language model embeddings (ESM-2).
highlights: Identified extreme coordinate anisotropy (PR/D = 0.0012, >83% energy in <= 4 rogue coordinates) causing a 2.58x orthogonal noise-inflation penalty.
Formulated and proved Support-Orthogonal Bleed Elimination and Analytical Bussgang De-Attenuation theorems, restoring unbiased inner products with zero data calibration.
Engineered multi-radix Lloyd-Max codecs (168 B - 488 B) surpassing trained FAISS OPQ (0.9993 vs 0.9968 Recall@20@30; 0.9600 vs 0.9180 Top-1 Recall) with 2x lower memory and zero training time.
Implemented high-performance Asymmetric Distance Computation in C with ARM NEON SIMD vectorization (0.35 ms/query, 234k vectors/sec).

projects.name: VectorWing: Drosophila Central Complex Connectomics
projects.description: Out-of-core connectomic graph analysis and dynamical circuit modeling using the FlyWire FAFB v783 dataset (16.8M synapses).
highlights: Built an out-of-core graph analytics pipeline processing 16.8M synapses under a strict <380 MB RAM ceiling on commodity hardware.
Identified that standard edge-swapping configuration models collapse physical reciprocity by 4.61x, conflating topological loops with chemical affinity.
Formulated degree-stratified conditional permutation null models, isolating a true +20.6% to +31.8% GABA-GABA excess in the Ellipsoid Body (Z > +13, p = 0.0005).
Discovered a 2.53x to 5.92x heterotypic ACh <-> GABA reciprocity inversion in the Fan-Shaped Body with 100% strict directional chemical polarity (554 dyads, p < 0.001).
Implemented a 16-column continuous rate model demonstrating subtractive feedback attenuation that caps columnar firing at 30.6 Hz and preserves heading bump tuning.

projects.name: Introspect - ML Observability Platform
projects.description: ML observability platform featuring a framework-agnostic model adapter for comprehensive model evaluation.
highlights: Enabled end-to-end evaluation of autoregressive and diffusion language models with telemetry, consistency scoring, and semantic drift analysis.
Instrumented telemetry via OpenTelemetry with an asynchronous FastAPI and SQLite backend.

projects.name: Cartoon-to-Realistic Image Translation using CycleGAN
projects.description: Deep learning image translation pipeline in PyTorch for domain translation from stylized cartoons to photorealistic images.
highlights: Prepared and curated unpaired datasets, designed the generator and discriminator training pipeline, and generated realistic images from cartoon inputs.
Utilized cycle-consistency loss, adversarial loss, and identity loss for high-fidelity cross-domain mapping.

projects.name: Supermarket Automation System
projects.description: JavaFX desktop POS and inventory management system following MVC architecture.
highlights: Implemented real-time billing, inventory tracking, customer loyalty management, and sales reporting using MySQL and JDBC.
Authored comprehensive unit tests with JUnit and Mockito to ensure robust business logic.
